hints.tr: `while heap:` içinde `d, node = heapq.heappop(heap)`; `node in done` ise `continue`, değilse `done.add(node)`.
hints.en: Inside `while heap:`, `d, node = heapq.heappop(heap)`; `continue` if `node in done`, otherwise `done.add(node)`.

hints.tr: Her `nxt, w` için `d + w < dist.get(nxt, math.inf)` ise güncelle ve `heapq.heappush(heap, (d + w, nxt))`.
hints.en: For each `nxt, w`, if `d + w < dist.get(nxt, math.inf)`, update and `heapq.heappush(heap, (d + w, nxt))`.
